title: Tksv's Cobblemon Pack
body:
# 📦 About the Modpack

This modpack was created to enhance the Cobblemon experience, blending it with the creativity of the Create mod and a selection of cozy, atmosphere-focused additions. The goal is to keep the gameplay lightweight, immersive, and true to Minecraft’s style—while making the world feel more alive and enjoyable.

# ✨ Purpose & Vision
- The idea behind this modpack is to offer a balanced experience:
- Cobblemon as the core, integrated seamlessly into the Minecraft world;
- Create for players who enjoy mechanical builds, automation, and engineering;
- A curated set of cozy and quality-of-life mods that improve visuals, comfort, and immersion—without bloating performance or overwhelming the gameplay.

The result is a calm, creative, and adventure-friendly environment perfect for both solo and multiplayer worlds.

**This modpack is still in development.**
